# Schedule

**Figma:** Schedule/Resource-Grid, Itinerary, Slot-Picker, Day-Planner and .Primitives/Schedule/* (page ❖ Schedule 16121:6)  
**Import:** `import { ScheduleResourceGrid, ScheduleItinerary, ScheduleSlotPicker, ScheduleDayPlanner } from "@zen-ds/react";`

Plan time around people, rooms and stops: who is booked when (Resource-Grid), a day's programme (Itinerary), bookable times (Slot-Picker) and one person's day as cards (Day-Planner). Built on the Calendar parts (Event-Block bars, the now line, the week strip); dates are Dates or local ISO strings.

## Use it for
- Shift planning, room and equipment booking, team leave: ScheduleResourceGrid (scale hours for a day, days for a week).
- Event programmes, a delivery route, a day of visits: ScheduleItinerary.
- Booking a meeting or an appointment: ScheduleSlotPicker, with the confirm action in the page or sheet footer.
- A person's day on a phone or in a side panel: ScheduleDayPlanner.

## Use something else for
- One person's week of hours → CalendarTimeGrid.
- Unrelated events in date order → CalendarAgenda.
- Any time of day in a form → DatePicker with timePicker.
- Tasks across weeks → a Gantt (Timeline, not in code yet).

### ScheduleResourceGrid
Figma `Schedule/Resource-Grid` (16135:145822): a resource timeline. A Border box (`Color/Background/Surface/Default`, 1px `Color/Border/Neutral/Pale/Default`, Corner-Radius/Base, clipped): a 40px header (the resource column's label and the scale, Caption/Medium Neutral/Base; today in Accent on the Days scale) over rows of `.Primitives/Schedule/Resource` beside their track, one fixed height (56 desktop, 64 mobile), split by Pale rules that sit outside the layout. Bookings are `.Primitives/Calendar/Event-Block` bars: x = start on the scale × column + 2, width = length × column − 4, 4px from the row's top and bottom; a bar that runs past the range scrolls with the track and is never squeezed to its edge; under 80px it hides its time. A vertical `.Primitives/Calendar/Now-Line` crosses the tracks at now. Semantics: a `role="table"` — the header row's column headers, then per resource a row header and one cell with the bars (buttons with `onBookingClick`, named by title and time). On a phone the resource column stays while the scale scrolls.

Also accepts `HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `resources` (required) | _HTML attribute_ | — | The rows: people and rooms, in order. |
| `bookings` | _HTML attribute_ | `[]` | The bookings, shifts and leave on them (by `resourceId`). |
| `scale` | `"hours" \| "days"` | `"hours"` | Figma Scale: `hours` (one day, a column per hour) or `days` (one week, Monday first). Default hours. |
| `date` | `Date \| string` | — | The day shown (Hours) or any day of the week shown (Days). Default: today. |
| `startHour` | `number` | `9` | First hour of the Hours scale (default 9). |
| `endHour` | `number` | `17` | Hour the Hours scale ends at (default 17: eight working hours). |
| `now` | `Date \| string` | — | The current time: the vertical now line while it is inside the range. Default: the device clock. |
| `today` | `Date \| string` | — | The day treated as today (the Days scale writes it in Accent). Default: `now`'s day. |
| `resourcesLabel` | `ReactNode` | — | The header of the resource column (default the locale's "Team & rooms"; "Team" on a phone). |
| `onBookingClick` | `(booking: ScheduleBookingData, target: HTMLElement) => void` | — | Pressing a bar: open the booking, anchored to `target`. Without it the bars are static. |
| `selectedBookingId` | `string \| null` | `null` | The booking whose details are open: its bar shows State=Selected. |
| `device` | `"desktop" \| "mobile"` | — | Figma Device: `desktop` (200px resource column, the whole scale visible) or `mobile` (64px column, four hours visible: the track scrolls sideways and opens at the current hour). Default: from the breakpoint. |
| `aria-label` | `string` | — | Names the grid (default: "Team & rooms" and the period). |
| `overrides` | `Readonly<Record<string, Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>>>` | — | Figma instance overrides of the rows' Resource and the bars (`{ "Row[alex]/Resource": { device: "mobile" } }`). Written by Zen Studio. |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLDivElement>` | — | Ref to the root `<div>`. |

### ScheduleItinerary
Figma `Schedule/Itinerary` (16135:13820): a day's programme — a Body/Small/Bold kicker (Neutral/Light) over `.Primitives/Schedule/Itinerary-Item` stops, Gap/XSmall; stops that ended are Past (Accent rail) up to the one happening Now; the last stop has no connector. An ordered list: the running stop carries `aria-current="step"`. Not a calendar of unrelated events (CalendarAgenda) or a history of actions.

Also accepts `Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "title">`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `stops` (required) | _HTML attribute_ | — | The stops, in order. |
| `title` | `ReactNode` | — | Figma Kicker: the day and the plan's name ("Wed, Sep 30 · Design Day"). |
| `now` | `Date \| string` | — | The current time: stops that ended are Past, the running one Now, the rest Upcoming. Default: the device clock. |
| `device` | `"desktop" \| "mobile"` | — | Figma Device: `desktop` (640) or `mobile` (358); the stops are the same. Default: from the breakpoint. |
| `overrides` | `Readonly<Record<string, Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>>>` | — | Figma instance overrides of the stops (`{ "Stop[keynote]": { connector: false } }`). Written by Zen Studio. |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLDivElement>` | — | Ref to the root `<div>`. |

### ScheduleSlotPicker
Figma `Schedule/Slot-Picker` (16135:14046): a booking picker, one `.Primitives/Schedule/Slot` chosen at a time (a radio group). Desktop: day columns Gap/Small apart, each a header (weekday Caption/Medium Neutral/Light — "Today" in Accent/Base — over the date in Body/Base/Medium) and its slots Gap/XSmall, filling the column. Mobile: a Calendar/ Week-Strip (Dot) Gap/Medium over Morning / Afternoon / Evening groups — a Body/Small/Bold Light kicker, Gap/XSmall, then slots three per row Gap/Small apart. Booked or past times are Disabled, struck through, still in place. Each radio is named with its day and time; the arrow keys move between them.

Also accepts `Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "defaultValue" | "onChange">`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `slots` (required) | _HTML attribute_ | — | The bookable times (any days); a day shows its slots in time order. |
| `days` | _HTML attribute_ | — | The days to offer (desktop columns, the phone's week strip). Default: the days the slots fall on, at most five. |
| `value` | `string \| null` | — | The chosen slot's id (controlled). |
| `defaultValue` | `string \| null` | `null` | The chosen slot at first (uncontrolled). |
| `onValueChange` | `(id: string, slot: ScheduleSlotData) => void` | — | Called with the slot the person picks. The confirm action ("Book 10:00") belongs to the page or sheet footer. |
| `day` | `Date \| string` | — | Phone: the day the slots show (controlled). Default: the chosen slot's day, else the first day. |
| `onDayChange` | `(day: Date) => void` | — | Phone: called with the day picked on the week strip. |
| `today` | `Date \| string` | — | The day treated as today ("Today" in Accent). Default: the device clock. |
| `device` | `"desktop" \| "mobile"` | — | Figma Device: `desktop` (day columns) or `mobile` (a week strip, then Morning / Afternoon groups of three per row, 44px touch targets). Default: from the breakpoint. |
| `aria-label` | `string` | — | Names the times (default the locale's "Available times"). |
| `name` | `string` | — | The radios' group name (default a generated one). |
| `overrides` | `Readonly<Record<string, Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>>>` | — | Figma instance overrides of the slots (`{ "Slot[2026-10-01T10:00]": { size: "sm" } }`). Written by Zen Studio. |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLDivElement>` | — | Ref to the root `<div>`. |

### ScheduleDayPlanner
Figma `Schedule/Day-Planner` (16143:1439): a person's day — the month as a Heading/3 title with a selector (Button/Icon-Main Small Tertiary, Gap/XSmall), a Calendar/Week-Strip Style=Tile, a Divider, then an hour rail of `.Primitives/Schedule/Hour-Label` (the current hour Now) beside `.Primitives/Schedule/Event-Card` cards at their start time, Gap/Medium between the parts and Gap/Small between rail and cards. A card's top is (start − first hour) × the hour height and its height the longer of length × hour height − 8 and its content; the hour height (64) grows so cards never overlap. Cards and the selected day are Border boxes, so the planner reads on any canvas.

Also accepts `Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "title" | "defaultValue" | "onChange">`.

### ScheduleSlot
Figma `.Primitives/Schedule/Slot` (16133:1087): one bookable time, a radio of the picker's single-choice group, in the Date-Picker day's colours: `--zen-date-picker-item-background-unselected-*` with a 1px Border/Neutral/Subtle (Hover: Subtle/Hover), Selected `--zen-date-picker-item-background-seclected-default` with its Selected content, Disabled a Border/Disabled outline and Content/Disabled struck through. ### ScheduleItineraryItem
Figma `.Primitives/Schedule/Itinerary-Item` (16133:1131): one stop of a timed plan. Gap/Small between a 56px time column (Start Body/Small/Bold over Duration Caption/Regular Light, Gap/3XSmall), a 16px rail (the marker, then a 2px connector, Padding-top 2XSmall, Gap/2XSmall) and the content (Title Body/Base/Medium, Meta Caption/Regular, Gap/2XSmall, Padding-bottom Large). Past: Accent/Solid dot and connector, Start / Title / Meta quiet (Light, Base, Light). Now: a 16px Surface ring with a 2px Accent/Solid stroke and a 6px Accent dot, a Badge Small Accent Subtle "Now". Upcoming: a 12px Surface dot with a 2px Border/Neutral/Solid stroke. Connectors after Now are Border/Neutral/Subtle.

Also accepts `Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "title">`.

### Types
Object shapes the props above refer to.

```ts
type AvatarTheme = "photo" | "accent" | "blue" | "brown" | "crimson" | "cyan" | "green" | "indigo" | "neutral" | "orange" | "pink" | "plum" | "purple" | "red" | "teal" | "violet" | "yellow" | "sky" | "mint" | "bronze" | "golden"
type CalendarColor = "brand" | "blue" | "violet" | "teal" | "green" | "orange" | "pink"
type CalendarDateInput = Date | string
interface ScheduleBookingData { id: string; resourceId: string; title: string; start: CalendarDateInput; end: CalendarDateInput; color?: CalendarColor; time?: string; }
interface ScheduleCardData { id: string; title: string; start: CalendarDateInput; end: CalendarDateInput; color?: ScheduleColor; status?: string; note?: string; attendees?: Array<{ src?: string; alt?: string }>; }
type ScheduleColor = CalendarColor | "neutral"
interface ScheduleSlotData { id: string; start: CalendarDateInput; disabled?: boolean; }
```

## Keyboard
| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Tab / Shift+Tab | Move between bookings, the slot group, the week strip and the cards' menus |
| ← / → · ↑ / ↓ | Slot-Picker: the previous / next time (the radio group) |
| ← / → | Week strip: the previous / next day |
| Enter / Space | Open the focused booking; pick the focused day |

## ✅ Do
- Keep the confirm action ("Book 10:00") in the page or sheet footer, enabled once a time is chosen.
- Keep taken or past times in place (disabled, struck through) so the day keeps its rhythm.
- Pass `now` (and `today`) when your app's clock is not the device's, so Past / Now and the now line agree with your data.
- Give bars real start and end dates: a bar past the visible range scrolls with the track.

## ❌ Don't
- Don't hide taken slots: people then cannot tell a full day from an empty one.
- Don't use a Slot-Picker for filters or scopes: that is Chip advanced.
- Don't put several Now stops in an itinerary: one stop runs at a time.
- Don't stack many overlapping events in a Day-Planner: use CalendarTimeGrid, which splits the column.

## Accessibility
- The Resource-Grid is a table: the scale's column headers, then a row header (the resource) and one cell of bars per row; bars are buttons with onBookingClick, named by title and time.
- The Slot-Picker is a radio group of native radios, each named with its day and time ("…, unavailable" when taken); the arrow keys move between them.
- The Itinerary is an ordered list; the running stop carries aria-current="step" and a Now badge.
- Day-Planner cards are a list named by the day; a card's ⋮ is named "Actions for {title}".

## Content
- Statuses in words (Done, In progress, Upcoming); colour stays on the rule.
- Times are 24-hour in the locale (09:00); durations in minutes (90 min).

## Harness (`npm run usage:check`)
| Rule | Severity | Checks | Suppress with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `interaction/no-noop-handler` | warn | Every interaction a Zen control offers works: no no-op handlers (`() => {}`, `() => undefined`), which leave a field that ignores typing and ↑/↓ or a Dismiss that stays. Chat has chat/no-locked-interaction. | `zen-allow-noop-handler: <reason>` |
| `schedule/slot-picker-confirm` | warn | A Slot-Picker only chooses a time: without onValueChange the app never hears the choice, and the confirm action ("Book 10:00") in the page or sheet footer has nothing to book. | `zen-allow-schedule-confirm: <reason>` |
| `schedule/selected-needs-handler` | warn | selectedBookingId marks the booking whose details are open; without onBookingClick the bars are static, so the selection can never change. | `zen-allow-schedule-selected: <reason>` |
